# recent-work fixtures

A vault of its own, kept apart from `../../followups/*` so an item added for one
report never shifts the other's counts. Every note here exercises something
`tests/test-recent-work.sh` asserts: a labelled `## Built` day, an unlabelled
one, ticks with each of the four outcomes, a note with no `## Built` section at
all, and a note far outside the window.

`practices/backend/timeouts.md` exists only to give `vault_repos()` a
vocabulary — attribution matches prose against the names the vault already
records, so without it `alpha-service` in an item's text is just a hyphenated
word.
